title: RIKEN Fugaku supercomputer break-in, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by RIKEN, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: One national research supercomputer in Japan, offline since Nov 14. Up to 4,222 Fugaku users and 375 RIKYU users are affected, and stolen keys could reach other research computers.
who_is_affected: Registered users of Fugaku and RIKYU, who are researchers, and researchers waiting for time on the machine. Their contact details and any private keys stored on Fugaku were involved.

known.text: An outside party got into Fugaku's operational network between Nov 10 and 13, through the public status dashboard.
Malicious programs were installed on some servers.
430 private keys for outside systems were taken, 233 of them without a passphrase.
Fugaku was suspended on Nov 14 and has no restart date.

not_known.text: Whether the stolen keys were used to break into other organizations.
The exact method used to get past the dashboard.
When Fugaku will return to service.
